parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the individual switches on the wall switch panel, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator for turning an electrical circuit on or off, controlling the flow of electricity to a connected device.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or toggles between two positions (on/off) when pressed by the user.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another individual switch on the wall switch panel, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It toggles between on and off positions through a pivoting motion.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the third switch on the wall switch panel, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides control for another electrical load, functioning independently from the other switches.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a pivoting manner to open or close the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the switch panel, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the switches securely, allowing for wall mounting and electrical insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
